description.zh:
返回结果中，属性记录按时间排序的方式。取值：

- **0**：倒序。倒序查询时，**StartTime**必须大于**EndTime**。
- **1**：正序。正序查询时，**StartTime**必须小于**EndTime**。
description.en:
The sorting order of the returned property records. Valid values:

*   **0**: in reverse chronological order. In this case, the time that is specified by the **StartTime** parameter must be later than the time that is specified by the **EndTime** parameter.
*   **1**: in chronological order. In this case, the time that is specified by the **StartTime** parameter must be earlier than the time that is specified by the **EndTime** parameter.

description.zh:
要查询的设备名称。

><notice>
 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
属性记录的结束时间。取值为13位毫秒值时间戳，例如：1579249499000。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds, for example 1579249499000.

description.zh:
属性的标识符列表。
不可输入重复的属性Identifier。
<props="china">
- 设备的属性**Identifier**，可在物联网平台控制台中设备所属的产品的功能定义中查看，或调用[QueryThingModel](~~150321~~)，从返回的物模型数据中查看。
- 数字孪生节点的属性**Identifier**，可在物联网平台控制台的数字孪生工作台下的孪生节点的功能属性中查看。具体操作，请参见[孪生节点的功能属性](~~454999~~)。

</props>

<props="intl">设备的属性**Identifier**，可在物联网平台控制台中设备所属的产品的功能定义中查看，或调用[QueryThingModel](~~150321~~)，从返回的物模型数据中查看。</props>

> 如果设备的属性是自定义（非默认）模块**testFb**下属性**temperature**，则参数值为**testFb:temperature**。
description.en:
A list of property identifiers.  
Duplicate property identifiers are not allowed.  
<props="china">
- You can view the property **Identifier** of a device in the feature definition of the product to which the device belongs in the IoT Platform console, or by invoking the [QueryThingModel](~~150321~~) API and checking the returned Thing Specification Language model data.
- You can view the property **Identifier** of a digital twin node under the functional properties of the twin node in the Digital Twin Workbench of the IoT Platform console. For more information, see [Functional Properties of Twin Nodes](~~454999~~).

</props>

<props="intl">You can view the property **Identifier** of a device in the feature definition of the product to which the device belongs in the IoT Platform console, or by invoking the [QueryThingModel](~~150321~~) API and checking the returned Thing Specification Language model data.</props>

> If the device property is **temperature** under a custom (non-default) module named **testFb**, the parameter value is **testFb:temperature**.

description.zh:
要查询属性所属的设备ID<props="china"><ph>或数字孪生节点ID</ph></props>：

<props="china">
- 调用[QueryDeviceInfo](~~257184~~)接口，可查询指定设备的**IotId**。
- 在物联网平台控制台的**数字孪生体详情**页面，单击孪生节点，可查看**节点ID**。

</props>

<props="intl">调用[QueryDeviceInfo](~~257184~~)接口，可查询指定设备的**IotId**。</props>

><notice>**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
The ID of the device. The device ID is issued by IoT Platform.

>  The **IotId** parameter is a globally unique identifier (GUID), and corresponds to a combination of the **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** parameters. If you specify the **IotId** parameter and a combination of the **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** parameters at the same time, the **IotId** parameter is used.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
单个属性可返回的数据记录数量。最大值为100。
任意一个属性返回的数据记录数量不超过该值。
description.en:
The maximum number of records that is returned for each property. Maximum value: 100.

The number of records that are returned for an arbitrary property cannot exceed the limit.

description.zh:
要查询设备所属的产品ProductKey。

><notice>
 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

description.zh: 属性记录的开始时间。取值为13位毫秒值时间戳，例如：1579249499000。
description.en: The start of the time range to query. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds, for example, 1579249499000.

title.zh: 批量查询指定设备的属性上报数据
title.en: Batch query the property reporting data of a specified device

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
<props="china">
- 若查询数字孪生节点的属性数据，必须传入参数**IotId**，且取值为孪生节点ID。
- 目前本接口已不支持分页查询。调用本接口时，如果在指定时间段内，没有返回**PageSize**条记录，返回的**NextTime**和**NextValid**也是无效的。您可多次调用接口[QueryDevicePropertyData](~~69539~~)，一次输入一个**Identifier**进行查询。

</props>

<props="intl">目前本接口已不支持分页查询。调用本接口时，如果在指定时间段内，没有返回**PageSize**条记录，返回的**NextTime**和**NextValid**也是无效的。您可多次调用接口[QueryDevicePropertyData](~~69539~~)，一次输入一个**Identifier**进行查询。</props>

## 使用限制

- 一次调用下，最多查询10个属性的历史数据，最多返回100条数据。
- 标准型和尊享型企业版实例：仅可查询存储时效内的数据。数据存储时效，请参见[存储配置](~~464050~~)。
- 其他实例：仅可查询最近30天内的属性数据。    

## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
<props="china">  
- To query property data of a digital twin node, you must specify the **IotId** parameter and set its value to the ID of the digital twin node.  
- This API no longer supports paged queries. If fewer than **PageSize** records are returned within the specified time period, the returned **NextTime** and **NextValid** values are invalid. You can call the [QueryDevicePropertyData](~~69539~~) API multiple times, specifying one **Identifier** per call.  

</props>  

<props="intl">This API no longer supports paged queries. If fewer than **PageSize** records are returned within the specified time period, the returned **NextTime** and **NextValid** values are invalid. You can call the [QueryDevicePropertyData](~~69539~~) API multiple times, specifying one **Identifier** per call.</props>  

## Limits  

- A single API call can query historical data for up to 10 properties and return up to 100 records.  
- For medium and premium Enterprise instances: You can only query data within the data storage retention period. For details about data storage retention, see [Storage Configuration](~~464050~~).  
- For other instances: You can only query property data from the last 30 days.  

## QPS Limits  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API is 10 per Alibaba Cloud account.  
> All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of that account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-device-properties-data --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --page-size 10 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name airconditioning --start-time 1579249499000 --asc 0 --iot-id Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --end-time 1579249499000 --identifier example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot QueryDevicePropertiesData --region cn-hangzhou --Asc 0 --IotId Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --PageSize 10 --EndTime 1579249499000 --Identifier.1 'example-string' --StartTime 1579249499000 --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName airconditioning
